5837.title: [M156] Integrate upstream rendering and safety fixes
5837.body:
[M156] Integrate upstream rendering and safety fixes (#5837)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/467
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5857
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/0d6629ea961e42997af39b060c099a471b6088e1...8683c9d61cc19d51b33290c579ace5cc97c4de93

Bring the chrome/m156 fixes into release/4.156.x without changing the
managed API, native C ABI, or release versions. Advance externals/skia
and its cgmanifest registration to native merge
8683c9d61cc19d51b33290c579ace5cc97c4de93 and record upstream revision
9d96dfeb451c989d5d113d433835338f93a570f4.

~~ Avoid mipmap contamination in Ganesh image filters ~~

Ganesh image filtering could sample garbage from scratch textures after
falling into mipmap mode. Share downgrade_to_filter() between the shader
and texture SpecialImage drawing paths; a follow-up also fixes
unused-function compiler warnings in ImageFilterTest.

~~ Reject overflowing Ganesh buffer allocations ~~

Raw unsigned minSize + pad could wrap and cause an out-of-bounds padding
write in GrBufferAllocPool. Import checked alignment and size arithmetic,
reject invalid counts, cap buffer allocations, and allow allocation
failure to skip the draw instead of proceeding with an invalid buffer.

~~ Reset Graphite depth after overwriting draws ~~

Draws that overwrite all pixels discard earlier draws, but previously
left depth and bounds tracking intact. Repeated overwrites could wrap
depth and render out of painter's order. Reset the depth, stencil set,
and bounds manager when an overwrite follows non-initial depth.

~~ Bound FreeType LCD16 glyph copies in pixel space ~~

Consecutive glyph loads can produce different outlines and bounds. The
LCD16 path mixed pixel-space mask bounds with FreeType's 3x subpixel
bitmap, causing misaligned copies and assertions. Convert bounds to pixel
space before intersection, validate the bitmap, and crop both sides to
the overlap. Guard outline translation against SkFDot6 overflow and add
a divergent-outline regression.

~~ Clip destination reads to their bounds ~~

Ganesh now intersects the pipeline scissor with destination-read bounds
and applies a scissor whenever a destination read is present. This clips
geometry that overshoots incorrectly calculated draw bounds in that case.

~~ Preserve the reviewed tree when pinning the native merge ~~

The two-parent native merge directly includes reviewed commit
3f30fa40f8bd43ae32a9a690eb3df6d61fa91540 and has the same tree. The
dependent repin updates only the gitlink and its matching cgmanifest
commitHash; upstream provenance continues to identify the imported
chrome/m156 revision.

Independent regeneration matched the generated bindings. The sync PR
reports a successful Linux x64 source build and unfiltered managed test
run against the reviewed native tree; its local validation did not build
the Windows, Apple, mobile, WebAssembly, or Tizen native targets.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
